 "content": "def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    # The full-width 2 row separates two same-colored marker shapes.
    # Extend the upper marker downward in columns shared with the lower marker,
    # using color 4, stopping at the separator.
    bars = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if row and all(v == 2 for v in row)]
    if not bars:
        return out
    bar = bars[0]
    top_rows = [r for r in range(bar) if any(v != 0 for v in grid[r])]
    bottom_rows = [r for r in range(bar + 1, len(grid)) if any(v != 0 for v in grid[r])]
    if not top_rows or not bottom_rows:
        return out
    top = top_rows[-1]
    bottom = bottom_rows[0]
    top_color = next((v for v in grid[top] if v not in (0, 2)), None)
    bottom_color = next((v for v in grid[bottom] if v not in (0, 2)), None)
    if top_color is None or top_color != bottom_color:
        return out
    shared = [c for c in range(len(grid[0])) if grid[top][c] == top_color and grid[bottom][c] == bottom_color]
    for c in shared:
        for r in range(top + 1, bar):
            if grid[r][c] == 0:
                out[r][c] = 4
    return out
